title: add benchmark-lab reporting pipeline v37: representative runners + profiling baselines
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds V37 of the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline: new representative workload runners, updated profiling baselines, an Airflow DAG to ingest runner output into the reporting DB, and dashboards to track regressions. No API breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: the benchmark lab needs more representative workload runners for multi-variant profiling and stable baselines to detect regressions introduced by recent runtime scheduling changes. This PR adds: 1) a set of representative workload runners for HTTP/text-generation, streaming, and embeddings workloads; 2) profiling baselines for cold/warm starts across the most common GPU instance shapes; 3) an Airflow reporting DAG that ingests runner results, normalizes metrics, and writes to the reporting DB; 4) dashboards and CI checks to validate runner outputs. Goals: make it easy to add new runners, ensure baselines are versioned, and provide automated regression alerts tied to Linear test sets. Checklist:
- [x] Add representative runners (benchmark-lab/runners/replicable/*)
- [x] Add profiling baseline manifests and upload tooling (benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/)
- [x] Airflow DAG + ingestion operators (infra/airflow/dags/benchmark_reporting_dag.py)
- [x] Reporting DB migration scripts (infra/migrations/20241105_add_benchmark_reporting.sql)
- [x] Dashboard templates (observability/dashboards/benchmark_lab_v37.json)
- [x] CI integration tests for runner smoke tests (ci/benchmarks/smoke.yml)
- [x] Docs + quickstart (redwood-docs/benchmark-lab/v37.md)
Notes: This PR is scoped to pipeline and runner infra; it intentionally avoids changing serving runtime kernels. The profiling baselines include both CSV manifests and example outputs to make reviewable diffs. The Airflow DAG is feature-flagged and disabled by default in staging; enabling requires a config toggle documented in the README.

testing_instructions: 1) enable feature flag in platform-configs/feature_flags.toml for the target env; 2) run benchmark-lab/runners/replicable/* with SAMPLE_BASELINE=v37; 3) run tools/benchmark_uploader/upload_baselines.py to push manifests; 4) trigger Airflow DAG 'benchmark_reporting' manually and confirm records in reporting DB; 5) verify dashboard ingest shows new metrics.
